plain_english: Payments arriving 1–5 business days after the expected date are labelled 'late' — a small calendar slip. Beyond 5 business days the delay is too large to auto-approve; use 'late_needs_review' so an analyst can confirm the reason.

A shortfall of up to 1% of the expected amount is treated as a standard processing fee and labelled 'short_paid'. A shortfall larger than 1% is unusual (possible tax withholding, penalty, or data error); use 'large_deduction_needs_review' so an analyst can investigate.
